motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Tailwind default for shared control state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shared CSS media query shortens animation and transition durations and disables smooth scrolling.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared compact action; the large variant is 36px high.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 85%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Shared compact action; the large variant is 36px high.
components.css: .ds-button-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);background:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));}.ds-button-outline:hover{background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));}.ds-button-outline:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-button-outline:active{transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-outline:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-outline{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Email field
components.description: A labeled shared field with visible keyboard focus and invalid state.
components.css: .ds-label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-input{width:240px;max-width:100%;height:36px;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.85 0 0));border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:4px 12px;font-size:16px;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0)) 50%,transparent);}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--destructive, oklch(0.55 0.21 27));}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-input{font-size:14px;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Report navigation
components.description: Desktop text links from the opaque report header. Mobile uses a native disclosure.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}.ds-nav a{color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Published status mark
components.description: A text status from the illustrative network table, not a filter.

components.name: Report figure
components.description: Flat figure structure with a heavy top rule and explicit demo caption.
components.css: .ds-figure{margin:0;border-top:4px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));padding-top:12px;color:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));font-family:var(--font-sans-face,"Schibsted Grotesk"),ui-sans-serif,system-ui,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;}.ds-figure figcaption{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;}.ds-figure figcaption span{color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.4 0 0));}.ds-figure p{margin:16px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.85 0 0));padding:16px 0;font-size:14px;}

POST /api/posts

components.css: .ds-api{overflow:hidden;background:var(--primary, oklch(0.12 0 0));color:var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));}.ds-api-title{border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0)) 20%,transparent);padding:10px 16px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;}.ds-code{overflow-x:auto;}.ds-code:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--background, oklch(0.985 0 0));outline-offset:-4px;}.ds-code pre{margin:0;padding:20px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:13px;line-height:24px;}

narrative.overview: A Swiss annual report for a practical publishing tool: one grotesk, strong black rules, clear numbered sections and near-white paper. The existing logo, flat report figures and real dashboard captures carry the identity. Product imagery uses disclosed synthetic .example data.
keyCharacteristics: Numbered report sections and figure captions.
Heavy, tightly set headings with restrained body copy.
Square controls and authentic product screenshots.

rules.name: State Color
rules.body: Use chromatic color to communicate state; keep the surrounding report neutral.

dos: Do reuse the shared palette and Schibsted Grotesk.
Do use numbered sections for report wayfinding and captions to identify figures.
Do show real dashboard captures with disclosed fictional .example data.
Do preserve visible focus on controls and horizontally scrollable code.
donts: Don’t replace the confirmed identity with decorative gradients, rounded marketing cards or an unrelated display face.
Don’t present synthetic examples as customer evidence.
Don’t imply that Cloud is purchasable or has confirmed pricing.
